rule_or_pattern: drop lines whose chars-per-pixel is far below the book median (cpp_vs_book < 0.5): the crop is a different, full catalogue line while the label is a short continuation line. Secondary fix: relabel the format token regex `Σχ\. δον` -> `Σχ. 8ον` (8 read as δ).
notes: A 1903 bookseller's catalogue (author in caps, title, format, price); most labels match the print, including the bold and spaced type (1-3, 5-20). Two lines on p000021 are crop/label mismatches. Line 28's crop shows 'Πλήρης Σειρὰ Ἀποφάσεων Ἀρείου Πάγου' but is labelled 'Τόμοι 43 χρυσό'; line 37's crop shows 'Πλήρης Σειρὰ Θέμιδος Σγούτα' but is labelled 'Νομολογίας.'. Both have cpp_vs_book of 0.33 and 0.26. Recurring digit slip: the print 'Σχ. 8ον' is read 'Σχ. δον' in 4 and 29 (15 is read correctly). Line 40 also doubles 'φυσ φυσικόν'.
